items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Coleman Hawkins probably. He was there until about '34.

ctx.x: Yes. It was always rather slipshod, but always very much personality involved. I've forgotten who the players were, but that could easily be found out.
Coleman Hawkins probably. He was there until about '34.
